nom: Perricone MD Cold Plasma Plus+ Eye

avis.texte: I absolutely love it. It is a bit pricey, but it does the job.

avis.titre: Makes My Under Eyes Look More Awake
avis.texte: I really like this eye cream. It feels rich and hydrating without being too heavy, and it makes my under eyes look smoother and more refreshed. I notice the biggest difference with dryness and puffiness. My concealer goes on better when I use this too because the skin under my eyes feels more moisturized and less crepey. It is definitely one of the better eye creams I have tried.

Absolutely fabulous I amA Eye cream lady. I try most eye creams. But this by far I've seen results right away I've had it less than three weeks and I'm almost out. I cannot live with this ice cream and I love this brand highly recommended
this is perfect eye serum. i use 360 around the eye. inoticed the difference in 7th day. lesser lines, more firmer, no more dark circles.

I purchased this eye cream on a whim about 2 yrs ago during the 21 days of beauty sale. I knew nothing about the product other than I knew it is a good reputable brand. I had no real issues of aging around the eye area ( minimal) and really no under eye darkeness etc. Well, I used up the jar ( I loved the texture, feel and how it absorbed into skin) and needed to purchase again. However, I did not because the cream was full price. Within the few months after I ran out, I really did not notice just how well this product worked around my eye area until i stopped using it. I am currently using a brand just to suffice until hoping it would go on sale again. I am 52 y/o and have very sensitive, fair skin and never had any issues while using it. Give it a try. I am definitely going back to using thus product!!!
This product is pricey and for me appears not to work very well.
Simply the best ice cream out there for hydration of fine lines

I am in my mid-30s and I felt like my eyes were looking so tired. I had bags forming under my eyes that were making me feel self concious. I purchased this to help with that and my eyes are looking SO much better! I am obsessed with this cream. I have used the cream 2x a day for the past 2 months and I still have quite a bit left. All that to say, I definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: Great eye cream..for dark circles, wrinkles, etc
avis.texte: I have been using Dr. Perricone Cold Plasma eyes for over 10 years. It is the only eye product that treats dark circles and wrinkles and addresses the bags under my eyes..it feels wonderful when applied and I also apply it after applying makeup under my eyes..it reduces dryness. Love this product!
I got this as a duo and didn't really see any difference. I liked the cold plasma for my face, but not the eyes. I prefer the Perricone MD Essential Fx Acyl-Glutathione Eyelid Lift Serum.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Since using this product, I can tell a noticeable difference in my wrinkles around my eyes.

Wanted to love this product. Part of my fab fit fun box. Left my eyelids swollen the next am multiple times. I actually wasn't convinced it could be this product. Sure enough it was. Had to take Allegra to get the swollen eyelids down, thank goodness I work from home. Totally agree with the other reviewer, swollen, dry and burning results.

avis.titre: No more droopy eye lids or crows feet!
avis.texte: Wow! Let me know when the representative for Dr Perricone comes in the store again so I can tell them in person how absolutely fabulous their products are! I use it all .. neck, face, etc. Pricey yes, but wouldn't you pay the price if it works wonders not to mention what it does to your self esteem? After all, think of it, they don't make false faces! So, why not spend the money on an absolutely wonderful product that actually works and says what it says it claims it's going to do? Dr Perricone is a genius! 🤓

avis.titre: Wonderful eye cream and worth the price
avis.texte: I love how this eye cream is smooth and creamy. It absorbs into the eye area and makes the skin around my eyes soft. It is great at diminishing wrinkles and when used with Perricone MD Essential Eye Lift Serum, it works miracles. The combination of the two really are worth the price. The skin is the largest organ in the body and we are very hard on it and expect it to recover like it did when we were in our 20's. I was hesitant to use Perricone MD because of the price but it really is worth it. Perricone MD is the best skin care product I have ever used!

avis.titre: I Love THIS! and I have sensitive eyes
avis.texte: Ive use quite a few under eye products. Most burn so i stop using them and a few have definitely hydrated but this stuff!!! No burn...definitely hydrated...and i must say I do notice my eyes less puffy and less dark! Im just pleasantly surprised! I has to write a review. Im 37 soooo im older with some fine lines. I think ive found my new eye cream. I would recommend anyone to hive it a shot.

I got this cream in my recent FFF winter box and I already notice a difference. I had been using Clinique all about eyes and never saw much of a difference, until now, with this cream. Yes it's pricey, but worth it.

I would love love to get rid of my dark circles under my eyes! But I still had them! Overall it was a good cream, but so are a lot of other. If it gotten rid of my dark circles I would have loved this cream!

The Perricone MD cold plasma eye cream works! First tried it during a 21days of beauty sale and loved it. The reg. price kept me from buying it again. When I use it I constantly receive questions about what I use because my under eye area looks great compared to other women my age. (48) Just gonna have to start saving for the product and/or Splurging on 2 when it pops up in a sale. A little goes a long way, it's very moisturizing. Have to keep using it, results disappear when I use other eye creams. Eye cream cost less than plastic surgery.

This is an absolutely excellent eye cream. I have seen an improvement in my full orbital area including line reduction, de-puffing, brightness, and it glides on smooth as silk. Make sure to apply over the bridge of your nose to reduce frown creases!!! Worth every penny!!!

31 years old, 15-year smoker (recently quit). Started using this twice daily at 27. Since then, I have developed deep creases (well, deep for my age) on my forehead but ZERO signs of aging around my eyes. Mind consistently blown. Don't think I'll ever not use Perricone products. Note: Can cause milia if you use too much product and have oily skin—minimize application if you have this skin type.
Love this product! It is very moisturizing and helps me maintain moisture and reduce wrinkling.
Works the same as any other eye cream but want to charge you a fortune. The cold plasma "Extra" benefits are non-existent. It is just a basic moisturizer and not worth the money.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: Too early to tell if this product is helping with lines and wrinkles around the eye. This jar is perfect, however I have purchased in the past and the eye cream was very dry and hard to use. I threw it away and decided to give it another chance.
I use product morning and night. My skin is sensitive and I've had no issues. Could telll a Difference in a few days.

Not sure about this stuff. I tried it for 1 week and every morning I woke up with red, itchy, swollen eyes. I am a huge fan of Dr Perricone's line and moisturizers. But this stuff really doesn't seem like it is from the same brand. I had better results with Clinique which is less than half the price. My eyes literally stung all day even after washing this stuff off. It was moisturizing, just not sure about it. Probably discontinue. Side effects never went away.

I've used this for years and it's never disappointed. Smooths under eye fine lines wrinkles and crows feet. I ran out and tried another product and went right back to this. It works immediately and with continued use actually diminishes signs of aging.

Renew your eyes it's magical !!! I'm 41 and I recall using this product 5 years ago I decided to re buy and been using night and day as well as also keep hydrated with H2o peers at work asked me if I did something new and that I glow !!! I also recommend reading his book it has much knowledge and info on foods to eat to achieve youthful appearance. This Man has nailed it with giving you back years and enhacing your natural beauty Thank you !!!

Is it just me or has anyone else experienced drying under the eyes after using this? I have been using for more than a week & when I put makeup on (concealer) my skin is SO dry. A few hours after putting On makeup, I look like I've aged 10 years around my eyes. I've only been using before bed at night too. This seems weird as it claims to hydrate. Very disappointing! It's going back.

avis.titre: Doesn't do what it claims to
avis.texte: I had been asking my friend for recommendations for an eye cream that could help with dark circles, and she surprised me with this product for Christmas 2018. This lasted me for seven months, and I loved it! However, it doesn't do what it claims to. I only saw the slightest reduction in dark circles, and it did nothing for boosting firmness or reducing wrinkles. The reason I loved it so much is because it's so moisturizing. I get very dry skin (probably eczema) around my eyes and this is one product that solved that entirely, which is difficult to find. But, the price point isn't worth it for me to purchase this again.

After only one week of indulging in this product, my eyes are more youthful looking! Is it all in my head because I paid such an outrageous price for a product and therefore really want it to work? I don't think so because for one, I can FEEL the difference. My eye area feels so soft and smooth and just plain luxurious. Also, as I have matured I have found it increasingly harder to apply eyeshadow and make it look good according to my own standards. But yesterday, I was complimented by an Ulta employee (whose own makeup looked great, btw) on my eyeshadow and even wanted to know what I was wearing! I told her it Marc Jacobs but I was thinking to myself that the REAL reason my eye makeup looks so good is because I have been using Perricone MD. I have been using mostly cream shadows because I have become apprehensive about trying to get powder products to apply and blend out correctly in the allotted amount of time I have to get ready each day. But yesterday I finally felt confident to get out the powder palettes again. For the first time in a long time I had my eyes perfected and ready to go in less than 30 minutes! My makeup applying skills haven't changed; it has to be the eye cream! I have sit down and literally researched every single ingredient in Perricone MD Cold Plasma + Eye - hoping to find that it was just an ordinary eye cream using snob-appeal as a marketing technique. But my findings concluded that it is indeed a high quality product. So if you have the $$ to spend

I have been using this product in the morning and before bed as directed for a month now. I switched from the exuviance to try this and my eyes have never looked worse! I am 34 years old and have fine lines under my eyes that I want to minimize and prevent from getting worse. This product promise that you will see improvement in as little as one week. All that I've noticed is my eyes looking worse. Don't waste your money on this product.

I have very crepey undereye skin due to an over zealous eyelift that removed too much fat, I've tried every eye cream that sounded appropriate for my problems. THIS IS THE FIRST TO WORK FOR ME! It hydrates the skin all around my eyes (upper and lower) and makes the skin look refreshed and smoother.. I've never had a salesperson who encouraged me to try this line...wish they had. Highly recommend.
I thought this product was completely ineffective. I returned it.

avis.titre: I would buy this product forever! Took care of puffiness!
avis.texte: Awesome Product! Wonderful Results! This will help your skin... Be patient! Don't get discouraged because I was amazed how well it worked. This is an amazing line of products Perricone MD makes. Do some research and find which one will work for you.

I'm lucky to have purchased this on sale during 21 Days of Beauty and I've been using ever since. I had high hopes this would really reduce the lines and dark spots appearing around my eyes. Results are minimal so far for that, but he skin around d my eyes is very soft. I don't believe I'll buy this product again - there are less expensive items that do the same thing.
